content.comment_body: Hi, I need [product_name] [version_no] on USB because my laptop does not have a DVD drive. Where can I purchase the software? Thanks.
The software is only available as a DVD, not on a USB stick. You can buy the DVD, use a friend’s computer with a DVD drive to create an image of the disk, and then transfer it to a USB stick.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have trouble obtaining [product_name] [version_no] in a USB format as it is only sold on DVD. This creates accessibility challenges for those with laptops lacking optical drives, requiring extra steps to install the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to be available in formats suitable for modern laptops, such as USB or downloadable versions.
